   MEREDITH MCCALL ON BEHALF INTERVENORS WALTER AND DEBORAH

     MCCULLOUGH RESPONSE TO APPLICANTS’ OBJECTION TO EXHIBITS

        Meredith McCall on behalf of Walter & Deborah McCullough, pro se intervenors, hereby

responds to Applicants’ objection to exhibits on the grounds that the exhibits were not produced

as part of direct testimony or a discovery response, and respectfully requests the Administrative

Law Judges to overrule the objection and admit the exhibits into the record.




                                        I.   BACKGROUND

        Walter & Deborah McCullough (The McCullough’s), timely entered into this proceeding

but was yet to be officially admitted as an Intervenor in the case by the May 13, 2026 deadline

for direct testimony. Meredith McCall timely filed on behalf of Walter And Deborah

McCullough a statement of position and direct testimony pointing to 59182 docket for these

proceedings, without even knowing the party was admitted to the case.



McCullough Exhibits and Witness 59475                                                   Page 1 of 4
         On May 8, 2026, SOAH ALJ's issued Order No. 12 in 59475 (Item 3718) granting a

partial consolidation based on “need” of the 59182 and 59475 cases. As set forth in The

McCulloughs Motion to Intervene, The McCullough’s do not own any land through which any

route will intersect for Applicants' Bell County East to Big Hill transmission line, CCN 59475,

but their judicable interests are in each of the CCNs, 59182 and 59475, because they are one

IMPORT PATH 2 project, the 59475 CCN cannot operate without the 59182 CCN and vice-

versa. As such, pertinent information from the 59182 docket should be included in the 59475

application including direct testimony, transcripts, rebuttal testimony and other pertinent

information due the consolation on the “need” in 59475.




                                          II.     ARGUMENT

      On May 8, 2026, SOAH ALJ's issued Order No. 12 in 59475 (Item 3718) granting a partial

consolidation based on “need” of the 59182 and 59475 cases. As set forth in The McCulloughs

Motion to Intervene, The McCullough’s do not own any land through which any route will

intersect for Applicants' Bell County East to Big Hill transmission line, CCN 59475, but their

judicable interests are in each of the CCNs, 59182 and 59475, because they are one IMPORT

PATH 2 project, the 59475 CCN cannot operate without the 59182 CCN and vice-versa. As

such, pertinent information from the 59182 docket should be included in the 59475 application

including direct testimony, transcripts, rebuttal testimony and other pertinent information due the

consolation on the “need” in 59475.

      Furthermore Exhibits 1-3 are Direct Testimony of Meredith McCall representing the

McCulloughs. Exhibits 4-5 are briefs based on direct testimony and a discussion on the “need”,


McCullough Exhibits and Witness 59475                                                     Page 2 of 4
      per SOAH 12, the 59182 and 59475 dockets are combined on the premise of “need”. Exhibit 6-8

     ARE the rebuttal testimony from Applicant on 59182, Transcripts from 59182, and Applicants

     initial post hearing brief on 59182. All these exhibits are already on the record on 59182

     therefore should be included as part of the consolation of the two dockets per SOAH Order No.

     12.

        For the forgoing reasons, Ms. McCall on Behalf of the McCulloughs request that the

Administrative Law Judges:
